installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

set -Eeuo pipefail

# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

SERVER_DIRECTORY=/mnt/server
STEAMCMD_DIRECTORY="${SERVER_DIRECTORY}/steamcmd"
STEAMAPPS_DIRECTORY="${SERVER_DIRECTORY}/steamapps"

DNSMASQ_PID=""

cleanup() {
	if [ -n "${DNSMASQ_PID}" ]; then
		kill "${DNSMASQ_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
		wait "${DNSMASQ_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
	fi
}

trap cleanup EXIT

## Install and start the local DNS cache.
apt-get update

DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
	apt-get install \
	--yes \
	--no-install-recommends \
	dnsmasq-base

dnsmasq \
	--no-daemon \
	--user=root \
	--listen-address=127.0.0.1 \
	--bind-interfaces \
	--no-resolv \
	--server=1.1.1.1 \
	--server=1.0.0.1 \
	--cache-size=10000 \
	--log-facility=- &

DNSMASQ_PID=$!

if ! kill -0 "${DNSMASQ_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
	echo "dnsmasq failed to start." >&2
	exit 1
fi

printf '%s\n' \
	'nameserver 127.0.0.1' \
	'options ndots:0' \
	>/etc/resolv.conf

## Just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ -z "${STEAM_USER:-}" ]; then
	STEAM_USER=anonymous
	STEAM_PASS=""
	STEAM_AUTH=""
fi

## Download and install SteamCMD.
cd /tmp

mkdir -p "${STEAMCMD_DIRECTORY}"

curl \
	--fail \
	--show-error \
	--silent \
	--location \
	--output steamcmd.tar.gz \
	https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz

tar \
	--extract \
	--gzip \
	--verbose \
	--file steamcmd.tar.gz \
	--directory "${STEAMCMD_DIRECTORY}"

mkdir -p "${STEAMAPPS_DIRECTORY}"

cd "${STEAMCMD_DIRECTORY}"

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even when running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the installation process.
chown -R root:root /mnt

export HOME="${SERVER_DIRECTORY}"

## Install the game using SteamCMD.
steam_login=(
	+login
	"${STEAM_USER}"
	"${STEAM_PASS:-}"
	"${STEAM_AUTH:-}"
)

steam_update=(
	+app_update
	"${APPID}"
)

./steamcmd.sh \
	+force_install_dir "${SERVER_DIRECTORY}" \
	"${steam_login[@]}" \
	"${steam_update[@]}" \
	+quit

## Set up 32-bit libraries.
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIRECTORY}/.steam/sdk32"

cp \
	--verbose \
	linux32/steamclient.so \
	"${SERVER_DIRECTORY}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"

## Set up 64-bit libraries.
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIRECTORY}/.steam/sdk64"

cp \
	--verbose \
	linux64/steamclient.so \
	"${SERVER_DIRECTORY}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
